cases.title: All entries/parts, no total cap
cases.setup: 50 entries / 78 parts; one source 33 parts; page through full tails
cases.expected: archive has all 78 parts, all 50 entries, exact counts, 4 reasons
cases.required_evidence: Real SQLite → CLI output + manifest/member set

cases.title: Byte reconstruction and identity
cases.setup: UTF8/RU, binary, empty, long line and spaced JSON revision digest
cases.expected: all INDEXED SHA/revision/Git OID/ranges exact; binary not forced to text
cases.required_evidence: Independent output proof and raw fixture comparisons

cases.title: Atomic part crash windows
cases.setup: Kill before rename / after rename before checkpoint
cases.expected: temp not committed; valid renamed part rediscovered; no duplicated part
cases.required_evidence: Real exporter subprocess fault hook + resume hashes

cases.title: Crash during ZIP assembly
cases.expected: no ready receipt; next resume reuses parts and rebuilds ZIP safely
cases.required_evidence: Before/after stage hashes + closed valid final ZIP

cases.title: Disk-full / permission failure
cases.setup: Inject OSError at payload write and ZIP write separately
cases.expected: BLOCKED with specific reason; completed parts retained; no published success
cases.required_evidence: Injected I/O at real exporter boundaries, then successful resume

cases.title: Duplicate/concurrent resume
cases.setup: Two actual writer processes same export identity
cases.expected: OS lock permits one writer; second EXPORT_LOCKED; repeated completed build verifies/reuses
cases.required_evidence: Subprocess concurrency and identical member set

cases.title: Corrupted staged part
cases.expected: resume rehash detects damage and rebuilds only affected staged part from exact captured data

cases.title: Wrong batch/profile/unverified manifest
cases.setup: Tamper binding/JSONL hashes; revoke profile; pending snapshot; missing global proof
cases.expected: refuse payload build/publication with specific blocker, no identity substitution

cases.title: Explicit cancel/restart
cases.setup: Ctrl+C after at least one part; call --resume, then explicit --new-run
cases.expected: CANCELLED remains terminal; new run_id required; no startup auto resume
cases.required_evidence: Persisted terminal receipt and fresh run identity

cases.title: Offline links and hostile source paths
cases.setup: Move extracted directory; paths include Unicode/tab/newline/quotes/markup/reserved names
cases.expected: every relative link resolves; raw paths remain escaped metadata; no remote assets or HTML injection
cases.required_evidence: HTML/fragment walker + rendered manual opening scope

cases.title: Gaps and protected data
cases.setup: 4 non-INDEXED entries; add orphan raw chunk or forbidden payload
cases.expected: no raw gap payload; all_tracked_bytes_exportable=false; orphan/extra outputs rejected
cases.required_evidence: Exact exclusion member set and corruption rejection

cases.title: Rename-before-receipt / existing output conflict
cases.setup: Kill after final ZIP rename before external receipt; separately corrupt existing final
cases.expected: exact archive reconciles sidecars; damaged final blocks without silent overwrite

cases.title: Resource boundaries and ZIP64
cases.setup: Use incremental copy with small buffers; force ZIP64 writer path; exceed declared disk/time budget
cases.expected: no whole-corpus raw load, explicit resource blocker, valid ZIP64-compatible archive
cases.required_evidence: Measured fixture RSS/buffer path and ZIP64 archive inspection; no unmeasured >4GiB claim

cases.title: Manifest/legacy regression
cases.setup: Existing PR002 APIs and previous DB records after export
cases.expected: unchanged native INFO/ENTRIES/PARTS and scan/get/export/review behaviour
cases.required_evidence: Actual current required regression commands + before/after source rows

cases.title: Windows local opening
cases.setup: Extract/open exported INDEX.html on user-like Windows 11 environment
cases.expected: source↔parts/gaps navigation opens locally; Unicode/portable output paths correct

cases.title: Device responsiveness and memory
cases.setup: Run actual intended corpus on Dell-class device and compare cold/warm
cases.expected: record corpus scope/parts/disk/RSS/latency; budgets honest, no infinite-size performance claim
cases.required_evidence: Device metrics/config/run SHA; NOT_RUN until observed
